ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (40) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Attributions follow the print: «Франциск» (Frantsisk) is simply 'Francis', and the Ruskin lines keep «Джон Рёскин» (Dzhon Ryoskin, 'John Ruskin') and «По Джону Рёскину» (Po Dzhonu Ryoskinu, 'After John Ruskin'). In Strakhov's mine image «неправда» (nepravda) is 'untruth', «ложь» (lozh') 'lies', and «правда» (pravda) 'truth'.
Source observation: [21] The attribution «Лao-Тсе» is typed with Latin «a» and «o» inside the Cyrillic name (transcription slip); translated as 'Laozi'.
